system.description:
Give the [Curse] tag to the target hit by a [Shooting Attack] by this weapon. A target with this tag always has a -1 to their [Dodge Check]. This effect is treated as a Life Status.

A jet-black dart engraved with a cursed rune.  A weapon developed with reference to the obstruction magic used by <Enchantment Sorcerers>, it imposes a curse on the opponent it pierces and hinders its movement.

[Core Material](30G)+ (50G)+[ 1](15G)×5+Crafting Cost(75G)
